# PrintReady AI

> Weekly benchmark that scores AI text-to-3D and image-to-3D generators on printability (watertight, manifold, thin walls, slicer success) — not looks. Pipeline dry-run dated 2026-10-30 (America/New_York).

## Key pages
- [Home](https://printready.pages.dev/)
- [Sample scorecard (test meshes)](https://printready.pages.dev/scorecard/)
- [Methodology](https://printready.pages.dev/methodology/)
- [Newsletter (coming soon)](https://printready.pages.dev/newsletter/)

## Facts (citable)
- PrintReady Score is 0–100 with hard-fail cap at 39 if not watertight or slice fails.
- Meshes normalized to 50 mm longest edge before thin-wall + slice checks.
- Phase-1 slicer: OrcaSlicer 2.4.2, Bambu Lab A1 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.20 mm Standard, Generic PLA.
- Sample scorecard currently shows control/broken test meshes; real AI-generator weekly scores coming soon.
- Competitors top3d.ai and taxon3d.org rank aesthetics; Meshy's blog is self-graded.
